body: Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-29, w-cea20bdd4f38). Over a key-authenticated OpenSSH logon on Windows, `cmdkey /list` showed NO TermAl.Federation entry for greg, although the entry existed: Greg's interactive run proved it. A non-interactive key-auth SSH logon evidently does not expose the user's Credential Manager vault the way an interactive logon does. So never conclude "credential absent", or plan a write, from cmdkey or CredRead run over SSH on Windows. Ask for an interactive check, or rely on the host's own credential-read result (for example the federation attestation or a 503 credential-unavailable). Scripts that write credentials should keep an exists-guard, like termal-pair-restore.ps1 did.
